name: refine-matk
author: Ragnarok Offline
description: Weapon refining also raises MATK, so magic classes get something out of a blacksmith too. Off until you turn it on.

settings.label: MATK per +1 refine
settings.description: Flat MATK the main-hand weapon gains for every level of refine. A +10 weapon at the default of 2 grants +20 MATK. Set to 0 to turn the bonus off without disabling the mod.
